text:
Sam: quick heads up - canary p95 jumped to 480ms, deploy-bot paused at 30%. Thoughts: rollback or pin?
deploy-bot: AUTOPAUSE: Canary paused (30%) due to p95_latency > 400ms for 4m. Recommended: investigate, pin, or rollback.
Ravi: logs show increased KV eviction and a new batching header change. pinning to last stable should buy time.
Olivia: agree. prefer a routing-layer pin to v2.8.0 so we keep canary pods for debug. I can run it.
Sam: ping when you start. SRE_Oncall, prep rollback runbook if pin fails within 10m.
Olivia: running `redwoodctl release pin --env=staging --version=v2.8.0 --route=all` now (started 4280001180).
Ravi: seeing p95 drop to ~320ms after pin. still above goal but trending down.
SRE_Oncall: opened INF-2101 with rollback checklist and comm templates. If p95 > 350 after 10m execute full rollback to v2.8.0 image.
Sam: decision: if stable under 350ms for 10m -> keep pin and backport batching revert; else rollback.
Olivia: annotated release metadata per deploy-bot reminder. Will coordinate hotfix branch.
Sam: posting short update to #release-updates. keep monitoring and terse comms. :thumbsup:
